natural_language_question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders

natural_language_question: How many orders are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

natural_language_question: How many units have been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders

natural_language_question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM orders

natural_language_question: What is the gross margin?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue-cost)*1.0/SUM(revenue) AS gross_margin FROM orders

natural_language_question: What is the discount rate?
Show revenue by region
gold_sql: SELECT regions.region_name AS region, SUM(orders.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN regions ON regions.region_id = orders.region_id GROUP BY regions.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

natural_language_question: Show revenue by category
gold_sql: SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(orders.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

natural_language_question: What is the revenue by month?
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY substr(order_date,1,7) ORDER BY month

natural_language_question: What is the gross margin by category?
gold_sql: SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(orders.revenue-orders.cost)*1.0/SUM(orders.revenue) AS gross_margin FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY gross_margin DESC

natural_language_question: Top products by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT products.product_name AS product, SUM(orders.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

natural_language_question: What is the average order value in August?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01'

natural_language_question: What is the total revenue in July?

natural_language_question: Show revenue by segment
gold_sql: SELECT customers.segment AS segment, SUM(orders.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN customers ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

natural_language_question: How many units sold by category?
gold_sql: SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(orders.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC
